title: Sub-brands / Alternate layout
slide_intent: Change emphasis for an unfamiliar audience because a sub-brand label is less useful when people do not recognize the parent name.
strategic_value: A stronger core signature can help unfamiliar viewers connect a Duolingo initiative to its source.
demonstration: An alternate lockup specimen accompanies a condition for use when the audience may not know Duolingo but a sub-brand or team must be represented.
practical_value: Choose the alternate arrangement when audience familiarity requires greater master-brand emphasis.

content_islands.name: Alternate lockup construction
content_islands.spec: Place the large wordmark above the smaller sub-brand name at left, preserving the alignment lines and X, Y and 1/2Y annotations.

content_islands.name: Audience condition
content_islands.spec: Place the unfamiliar-audience rationale and conditional permission in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that the alternate arrangement puts greater emphasis on core branding for unfamiliar audiences.
reference_purposes.Application: The alternate lockup is an option when a sub-brand or team still needs representation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The stated condition concerns an audience that may be unfamiliar with Duolingo.

ingredient.name: Alternate sub-brand layout
ingredient.role: Lead with the core identity when familiarity is low.
ingredient.application: Use the alternate lockup when representing a sub-brand or team to an audience that may not know Duolingo.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical conditional option, not a universal replacement for the generic construction.
